name: Inconel
description: A nickel-chromium superalloy that maintains strength at extreme temperatures. Inconel lines fusion reactor chambers, forms turbine blades, and withstands the corrosive exhaust of scramjet engines. Machining Inconel is notoriously difficult and expensive, requiring specialized carbide or diamond tooling.
